newsitem.title: FINLAND: NOKIAN RENKAAT JUMPS ON '96 RESULT.
newsitem.headline: NOKIAN RENKAAT JUMPS ON '96 RESULT.

text.p: Shares in Finnish tyre maker Nokian Renkaat Oy rose sharply on Thursday after the company reported 1996 earnings up 24 percent on 1995, brokers said.
At 1535/1335 GMT Nokian Renkaat traded at 130.00 markka, up 13.00 markka or more than eleven percent, setting a life-high mark in lively 10 million markka trade.
"Its result was a bit better than expected," one broker said, predicting that the share would find its ceiling at around 150.00 markka.
"At recent levels of around 120 markka the share has not been expensive," said another. --Hki newsroom +358-9-680 50 245
